title: DeepSolo: Let Transformer Decoder With Explicit Points Solo for Text Spotting
summary: A single-decoder text spotter that represents each text instance with ordered explicit point queries and jointly decodes recognition and fine-grained text geometry.

mechanisms.name: Ordered explicit-point text geometry
mechanisms.description: Represent a text instance as ordered point queries and jointly decode its character sequence, centerline, boundaries, script, and confidence instead of reducing it to one merged box center.
mechanisms.limitations: This is a text-spotting mechanism on images. It does not establish semantic target identity, physical-instance authority, temporal reacquisition, metric arrival, user completion, or safety.
